0022600095.text: The Dallas Mavericks (0-1, 5th in the Southwest, 14th in the West) are on the road against the Indiana Pacers (1-0, 2nd in the Central, 7th in the East) in the second game of the 2026-27 season for Dallas, with Dallas on a one-game losing streak and Indiana on a one-game winning streak. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel), while Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 134-130 win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
